title.official: The Bletchley Declaration by Countries Attending the AI Safety Summit, 1-2 November 2023

issuer.name: Countries attending the AI Safety Summit (UK-hosted), including the European Union

relevance.reason: The first international political declaration on frontier AI safety, agreed by 28 countries and the European Union at Bletchley Park. It establishes a shared understanding of opportunities and risks and a commitment to international cooperation, but is non-binding.
ai_provisions: Whole declaration — frontier AI risks, safety, international cooperation and continued dialogue
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding political declaration; no legal obligations, monitoring or enforcement.

dates.notes: Agreed at the AI Safety Summit, Bletchley Park, 1–2 November 2023. New Zealand joined the declaration on 23 October 2024.

status_note: Adopted by 28 States and the European Union on 1 November 2023; New Zealand joined on 23 October 2024. The record lists 29 States and the EU as of 23 November 2026. Political endorsement, not a treaty signature or ratification.

parties.summary: 29 States and the European Union are recorded as endorsers: 28 States and the EU at adoption on 1 November 2023, plus New Zealand, which joined on 23 October 2024. Endorsement is political; it is not a treaty signature or ratification.

notes: Joined on 23 October 2024; not among the 28 States represented at the 2023 summit.

reservations: None: the declaration is not a treaty and has no reservations.
unknowns: No depositary or formal endorsement procedure is published; the GOV.UK page and its update note are the source for the list.
The date of New Zealand's accession is recorded on GOV.UK, but no separate instrument of accession is published.

languages.note: English text and a Latin American Spanish translation are published on GOV.UK. No authentic-language clause.

sources.note: Official text and list of participating countries; records New Zealand's accession on 23 October 2024.
